passive.name: Living Forge
passive.description: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

spells.name: Volcanic Rupture
spells.description: Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing physical damage and Slowing by % for seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for seconds.

spells.name: Bellows Breath
spells.description: Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing % max Health magic damage over seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for seconds. Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.

spells.name: Call of the Forge God
spells.description: Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by % for seconds. Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for second and subsequent champions for seconds. The elemental also deals magic damage and reapplies Brittle.
